remaining_limits: Acceptance is limited to the two-round frozen changes, local cumulative patch reproducibility, three existing analysis inputs and finite digital geometry/replay checks. No browser end-to-end, fresh protocol generation, complete product acceptance or dedicated user test was performed by this reviewer.

The five-module catalogue remains a known negative static-layout fixture: Temperature V1 slot 5 and V2 slot 6 have 63.5 x 91 x 84 mm overlapping definition envelopes. This was independently recalculated; moving-tool sweeps do not test static pairs. Isolated module renders are diagnostic visibility changes only.

Discrete clearance uses actual-mesh AABBs plus existing primitive/exemption rules at 165/378/807 times; it does not prove surface separation, continuous collision freedom, physical fit or real hardware travel. Current TC park retains only approximately 1.2 mm to the Z upper limit.

Thermocycler travel was checked at 102 finite samples with exact reverse seek and a stable simplified hinge, but the full factory outer cover and physical opening envelope are not modeled or accepted.

Connection strap, knob, module casing/vent details, grill count, hidden construction and minor support dimensions are illustrative estimates from supplied references, not vendor CAD or measurements. No real temperature, magnetic effectiveness, airflow or biological outcome was validated.

A MuJoCo shadow artifact remains visible on some far-panel render angles. Disabling shadows removes it; sampled static grille views do not demonstrate flicker, but every possible camera/light configuration was not examined.
Sources and XMLs were read/loaded without regenerating frozen models; author reports were not used as substitutes for the independent calculations and image inspection described above.
